item.title: Equinor Makes New Discovery Near Oseberg
item.description: Equinor and its partners discovered oil and gas near the Oseberg field on Norway's side of the North Sea, with preliminary estimates of 19-50 million barrels of oil equivalent.

item.title: QatarEnergy CEO Says 'We Need to Keep Energy Above Politics'
item.description: 'Energy security must unite us, not divide us', Saad Sherida Al-Kaabi, Qatar's Minister of State for Energy Affairs, and the President and CEO of QatarEnergy, said.

item.title: TC Energy closes First Nations investment deal for CGL pipeline
item.description: TC Energy has announced the closing of an investment agreement that grants five Indigenous communities an economic interest in the Coastal GasLink (CGL) natural gas pipeline in British Columbia, Canada.

item.title: ENGIE and CMA CGM to develop biomethane plant in Le Havre, France
item.description: ENGIE and shipping and logistics group CMA CGM have agreed a framework deal to jointly develop a large-scale biomethane production plant in Le Havre's industrial port zone in France.

item.title: Shell agrees to divest Nigeria gas distribution arm to Vaaris Energy
item.description: Shell, via its subsidiary Shell Petroleum, has reached an agreement to divest its entire interest in the Shell Nigeria Gas Group to Nigerian energy company Vaaris Energy.
